display.purpose: Hero headline only; branch names inside it in Courier Prime 700 at .78em, cambium-ink.

headline.purpose: Section headings; balanced wrap; a turning second line in italic cambium-ink.

title.purpose: Custody ledger questions with italic upper-roman counters; ledger column heads at 1.5rem.

body.purpose: Reading copy, optical sizing on; leads capped at 36em, section leads at 40em.

label.purpose: Accession labels, legends, file lists, tabs, code, check-run states, anything machine- or policy-produced.

docs-heading.purpose: MkDocs h1 (h2 1.75em with 2px ink rule above, h3 1.32em italic). Literata because IM Fell figures are old-style only.

shadows.name: mounted-sheet
shadows.purpose: Specimen sheet, mounted GitHub comment, terminal, field note.

shadows.name: button-primary
shadows.purpose: Pressed-paper primary button; deepens with a 1px lift on hover.

motion.name: ease-take
motion.purpose: The graft takes once on load: cambium line .7s, sap line 1.6s then fades, leaves unfurl 1.2s, label swings 1s, slip pins .9s; floor marker moves .5s.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: Stamp presses in once (.5s, from scale 1.18 rotate -16deg to rotate -12deg).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Rested state shown; transitions and smooth scrolling off. Nothing loops in any mode.

stampShapes.trivial: Single 2px ring circle, 116px, no inner outline.
stampShapes.logic: Dashed 3px rounded rectangle, 6px radius, 116x76px, inner 1px outline inset 8px.
stampShapes.sensitive: Double ring circle: 3px border plus 1px outline inset 9px, 116px; multiply blend on the light sheet.
stampShapes.gauge: Final logic cell: 2px dashed inner outline; final sensitive cell: 3px double inner outline.

darkMode.model: Closed cabinet: tokens re-pointed under prefers-color-scheme and data-theme, persisted as localStorage graft-theme.
darkMode.cabinetBand: The risk floor band is dark in both themes; inside it ink, ink-2, ink-3, rule, code-bg and cambium-ink re-point to cabinet tokens and stamp inks use their dark values.
darkMode.docs: MkDocs Material slate scheme mirrors the same values with --md-hue 150.

narrative.overview:
Every pull request is a specimen grafted onto a rootstock and mounted on a herbarium sheet: an accession label typed in a typewriter face, a determination slip pinned on by a second botanist, gummed linen tape at the graft union, corner crop marks, a faint centimetre graticule, and a risk stamp pressed across the sheet. Sections are numbered Plates with italic captions. The ground is a cool grey-green mounting board, the ink is iron-gall blue-black, and one living cambium green marks the graft union and the primary action.

Density is that of a scientific plate: generous section rhythm, ruled ledgers instead of boxed cards, and evidence (the managed comment, the policy file, the floor gauge) rendered faithfully rather than abstracted into marketing tiles. Dark mode is the closed herbarium cabinet: the board goes near-black green, the paper dims, and the cambium green brightens because it is the only living thing in the drawer. One band (the risk floor) is a cabinet in both themes.

The world rejects the gradient SaaS hero with floating UI cards and the cream-serif-terracotta editorial default: the ground is grey-green, not cream, and the only accent is green.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mounting-board ground, iron-gall ink, one cambium green.
Risk is a stamp: a word plus a shape, with hue as a second channel.
Three faces with fixed jobs: IM Fell for display, Literata for reading and actions, Courier Prime for labels, code and data.
Ruled ledgers and numbered Plates with captions instead of cards.
Paper depth: soft mounted-sheet shadows, tape, pins and slight rotation on pinned paper.
Dark mode is a closed cabinet, not an inverted page.

rules.name: The One Living Green Rule
rules.body: Green is the only accent. It marks the graft union, the primary action and links; nothing else on the page is coloured except a risk stamp.

rules.name: The Stamp Ink Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and the risk use of green belong to the risk classes `sensitive`, `logic` and `trivial`. They are never decoration, and they always arrive with a word and a shape.

rules.name: The Closed Cabinet Rule
rules.body: Dark mode re-points every token rather than inverting the page: board #0e1613, sheet #15201b, ink #e6ebe2, cambium brightened to #7cc94a and cambium-ink to #93d963, and the primary button turns light green with board-coloured text.

rules.name: The Typed Label Rule
rules.body: Anything a machine or a policy produced (models, paths, risk words, check names, gauge steps) is set in Courier Prime. Anything a person reads as argument is Literata.

rules.name: The Old-Style Figure Rule
rules.body: IM Fell has only old-style figures, so "Step 1" reads as "Step I". Where headings carry numerals (all docs headings), use Literata at display size (h1 2.4em/1.08, h2 1.75em with a 2px ink rule above, h3 1.32em italic) instead of IM Fell.

rules.name: The Paper Object Rule
rules.body: Only things that are physically paper on the sheet cast a shadow. Text blocks, ledgers and bands never do.

rules.name: The Stamp Shape Rule
rules.body: Each risk class has its own silhouette so it reads without colour: `trivial` is a single 2px ring circle; `logic` is a dashed 3px rounded rectangle (6px radius, 76px tall) with an inner 1px outline; `sensitive` is a double ring (3px border plus a 1px outline inset 9px) circle. The floor gauge repeats the cue: the final `logic` cell carries a 2px dashed inner outline, the final `sensitive` cell a 3px double one.

rules.name: The Graft Takes Once Rule
rules.body: Everything is visible at rest. On load the graft takes once: the cambium line and sap line draw (.7s and 1.6s on cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), the leaves unfurl, the label swings to rest, the slip is pinned, the stamp presses in. Nothing loops. The floor marker moves over .5s on the same curve. Under reduced motion all of it, plus smooth scrolling and transitions, is off.

dos: Do keep green the only accent: cambium for strokes and fills, cambium-ink for any green text.
Do give every risk class its word and its stamp shape (single ring, dashed rounded rectangle, double ring) wherever it appears.
Do set models, paths, risk words and check names in Courier Prime; set argument in Literata; keep IM Fell for display headings without numerals.
Do use Literata for docs headings and any heading that carries a digit.
Do caption figures as numbered Plates with an italic IM Fell plate number.
Do structure lists of facts as ruled ledgers (2px ink rule to open, 1px rules between).
Do re-point tokens for dark mode and inside the cabinet band instead of hard-coding new values.
donts: Don't use a cream ground, a terracotta accent, or a gradient hero with floating UI cards.
Don't signal risk or state by hue alone.
Don't use cambium (#2f8a22) for text; it falls below 4.5:1 on the sheet.
Don't put shadows on anything that is not a paper object.
Don't set step numbers or other digits in IM Fell.
Don't loop motion or hide content until it animates.
